note: Rates are DERIVED FROM REALISED FEES on the operator's own closed positions, not transcribed from a published tariff page. A published rate states what should have been charged; this states what was. Where the two disagree the measurement wins, because the measurement is what a backtest has to clear.

measurement.source: closed-position ledger, fee field over entry notional

undetermined: The per-leg taker and maker rates cannot be separated from this export. The closed-PnL record carries a single combined fee and no per-leg order type, so the four clusters at 7.26, 10.34, 13.62 and 19.98 bps are consistent with different order-type mixes and possibly different instrument classes, and the mapping is not recoverable.

Rates are expressed against ENTRY notional. Fees are charged on both legs, so a position whose price moved carries an exit-leg fee on a different notional; this inflates or deflates the ratio by roughly the size of the move.
The monthly median moves from 13.63 in 2025-11 to 7.74 in 2026-01 and back to 13.60 in 2026-07, which is a change in behaviour, tariff, or instrument mix that this export cannot distinguish.

derived_floor.note: The floor a research task must clear. Fee is measured here; execution is measured elsewhere and cited.
derived_floor.execution_basis: fill forensics over 29 reconciled round trips: taker slippage 4.46 bps plus spread 1.10 bps
derived_floor.superseded_note: Fees only, no execution component, and it matched the median realised fee rather than a conservative one. Retained solely for comparison against results published before 2026-08-04.

conservatism_check.note: 16 bps is a central figure, not a conservative one, and tasks should know which they are using.
conservatism_check.detail: Adding the measured 5.56 bps execution component to the realised fee distribution puts the median all-in at 16.0, the p75 at 19.2 and the p95 at 25.6. A quarter of positions paid more than 13.6 bps in fees alone, which exceeds the entire superseded 11 bps floor.

review_criterion: Replace, do not amend, on any of: a change of venue, a change of fee tier, or a published tariff carrying dated per-leg taker and maker rates that would let the four clusters be decomposed. A new entry is appended with its own effective_from; existing entries are never rewritten, so a result computed under an old schedule stays reproducible.
source_of_record: derived from the closed-position ledger on 2026-08-05, cross-referenced against the fill forensics and the 2026-08-04 cost audit
